title: Actions & Extra: Java Edition
description: Transform your Minecraft experience with immersive 3D visuals, organic creature animations, and industry-leading performance optimizations.
body:
# Actions & Extra: Java Edition
### Overview

Actions & Extra: Java Edition is a carefully curated, high-performance optimization and visual enhancement modpack designed to breathe life into Minecraft. Built on the blazing-fast Fabric framework (with Sinytra Connector support), this pack transforms the standard Minecraft experience into a fluid, deeply immersive, and dynamic masterpiece without compromising the core vanilla feel.
Key Features & Categories

### 🎬 Alive & Dynamic Animations

The core identity of this modpack revolves around making the world feel organic, expressive, and lively:

- Fresh Animations & Extensions: A comprehensive overhaul of vanilla mob animations, adding detailed blinking, breathing, and custom situational behaviors for all creatures (including Player Extensions, Details, and full extension support).

- Not Enough Animations & 3D Skin Layers: Adds missing third-person animations (eating, drinking, climbing, rowing) and renders player skins with stunning 3D depth.

- Chat Animation: Adds smooth, fluid transitions to the in-game chat interface for a modern look.

### 🍃 Immersive Visuals & 3D Enhancements

Brings depth and vibrancy to the environment through cutting-edge resource pack integrations and standalone visual enhancements:

- Actually 3D Stuff & Fresh Flowers and Plants: Converts flat vanilla elements, items, flowers, and foliage into gorgeous, detailed 3D models.

- Subtle Effects, Particle Rain & Explosive Enhancement: Enhances the ambient atmosphere with realistic weather particles, overhauled explosion visuals, and polished magical/combat effects.

- Freshly Creepers & Baby Animals Remastered: Introduces gorgeous visual variations and texture updates to make wildlife and monsters feel completely unique.

    Enchantment Outlines & Armory Conglomery: Striking visual upgrades for enchanted gear, weapons, and armor presentation.

### ⚡ Blazing Performance & Modern Optimization

Engineered from the ground up to run exceptionally smooth, utilizing industry-leading performance mods to guarantee high FPS and stability:

- Sodium & Sodium Extra: Next-generation rendering engine offering unparalleled FPS improvements and advanced graphic settings.

- Iris Shaders: Fully integrated, high-performance shader support to customize your world's lighting and atmosphere.

- Lithium & FerriteCore: Deep engine and memory optimizations to maximize ticks-per-second (TPS) and drastically minimize RAM usage.

- Entity Culling & ModernFix: Skips rendering hidden entities/blocks and fixes major engine bottlenecks to stabilize frame rates.

- C²ME (Concurrent Chunk Management Engine) & Noisium: Multi-threaded chunk generation and optimized noise calculation for seamless world exploration.

- BadOptimizations & Krypton: Micro-optimizations to client rendering and a highly optimized network stack for smoother multiplayer gameplay.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life & Seamless Utilities

Essential tools that improve navigation, inventory management, and general gameplay comfort:

- Just Enough Items (JEI): The gold standard for recipe viewing, item searching, and fluid crafting layout.

- Mouse Tweaks & Hold My Items: Intuitive inventory controls and enhanced visual handling mechanics.

- Chat Heads: Displays player skin heads next to chat messages for better community communication.

- Zoomify: A highly customizable, smooth, and cinematic zoom tool.

- AppleSkin: Direct HUD visualization of food saturation, hunger values, and nourishment.

### 🧱 Compatibility & Core Frameworks

A robust backend foundation ensuring flawless interaction between OptiFine-reliant resource packs and complex mods:

- Sinytra Connector & Forgified Fabric API: Unlocks cross-toolchain compatibility, letting you run Forge-compatible mods seamlessly on Fabric.

- EMF (Entity Model Features) & ETF (Entity Texture Features): Delivers full OptiFine-format custom entity model (CEM) and random texture support natively on Fabric (essential for Fresh Animations).

- Polytone & Animatica: Custom color maps, smooth biome transitions, and animated GUI/texture support.

- Essential Configuration Engines: Powered by Cloth Config, YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL), Fzzy Config, Mod Menu, and Respackopts for complete control over your gameplay settings.
